pages.text: SYN Daily Ledger analyst note on Ndege Energy (SYN). The analyst set a twelve-month target price of SYN Sh 102.91 for NDE0. Trading volumes were broadly in line with the previous month, according to exchange data. The development follows a year in which small investors have shown growing interest in formal products.
